title: The 18th Century Eccentric Who Did Everything Wrong and Got Rich

lines.text: In twenty eleven, a normal bartender found a glitch that gave him infinite free cash.
lines.caps: IN TWENTY ELEVEN | A BARTENDER | INFINITE CASH

lines.text: Dan Saunders walked up to an ATM at one in the morning just to check his balance.
lines.caps: DAN SAUNDERS | AT ONE A M | TO CHECK BALANCE

lines.text: The screen showed an error, but the machine still spat out two hundred dollars.
lines.caps: SCREEN ERRORED | STILL SPAT OUT | TWO HUNDRED

lines.text: See, between one and three in the morning, the bank's network disconnected for daily maintenance.
lines.caps: BETWEEN ONE AND THREE | NETWORK DISCONNECTED | DAILY MAINTENANCE

lines.text: During that window, the ATM could not verify balances, so it simply approved every transaction.
lines.caps: COULD NOT VERIFY | SO IT APPROVED | EVERY TRANSACTION

lines.text: Over the next four months, Dan withdrew one point six million dollars in cold hard cash.
lines.caps: OVER FOUR MONTHS | ONE POINT SIX MILLION | IN COLD CASH

lines.text: He chartered private jets, bought five star suites, and threw wild parties for strangers.
lines.caps: CHARTERED JETS | FIVE STAR SUITES | WILD PARTIES

lines.text: Eventually, the guilt became so crushing he called the bank to confess.
lines.caps: GUILT CRUSHING | CALLED THE BANK | TO CONFESS

lines.text: Except the bank was so embarrassed by the glitch, they hung up on him and refused to call the police.
lines.caps: SO EMBARRASSED | THEY HUNG UP | REFUSED POLICE

lines.text: Leaving Dan with bags of cash, and the wildest two hour loophole in banking history.
lines.caps: BAGS OF CASH | WILDEST LOOPHOLE | IN BANKING HISTORY
